messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a micro-wave canary for routing v2 tomorrow.
alex: Target window: 03:00–04:30 UTC. Goal is 3% traffic for 30m, then 10% for 30m, then 30% if green.
alex: Cohort split: 60% EU users, 40% NA users for the initial 3% (geo sampling). We want NA preferred for later steps.
alex: Who can own smoke checks + rollback watch on-call? Need someone to be reachable during window.
maria: I can own the smoke checks for the first two steps. Will be available in the window. :raised_hands: 
jin: I'll monitor latency and error budget dashboards and keep a watch on tail latency.
sam: I'll be on standby for quick rollback. If >=1.5x error rate or 5xx spike for 5m, roll back to v1.
elaine: Add me to paging if anything >5% error rate over baseline. Also can run quick verification prompts.
alex: Thanks — @maria @jin @sam @elaine — assigning you now.
alex: Deploy-bot, schedule the canary per this plan: (pseudo-rule)
alex: ```
# traffic-split config
- step1: pct=3, geo={EU:60,NA:40}, duration=30m
- step2: pct=10, geo=NA-first, duration=30m
- step3: pct=30, full roll if green
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: start=2103500000, steps=3. Notifying owners.
maria: I'll post smoke checklist in #eng-oncall 10m before start.
jin: Quick QA probes I'll run:
jin: ```
curl -X POST https://api.example/replay -d '{"prompt":"stability test"}'
# assert latency < 350ms p95
# assert no new regressions in tokens/resp
```
sam: Rollback playbook link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/rollback-v2
sam: I'll be ready to execute manual rollback within 5m of decision.
alex: If all green at 30%, we hold 1h before full rollout; otherwise we pause and triage.
maria: A note on metrics: enable detailed traces and keep KV cache hit rate monitoring on.
elaine: I'll run 20 rand users churn test in staging right now and post results.
deploy-bot: Owners acknowledged: maria jin sam elaine. Alerts configured: latency/error/delta-modelscore.
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release ticket and mark the canary as 'micro-wave geo-sample'. Ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
